_comment: Email each SIGNAL NYC lead gets right after opting in on the Meta instant form. Used by src/app/api/meta-leads and ads/signal-nyc/publish.py (backfill). {{firstName}} is filled in per lead.
subject: Your SIGNAL NYC details: Oct 15, Hudson Yards
text:
Hi {{firstName}},

Thanks for requesting a spot at SIGNAL NYC. Here's everything you need.

WHEN: Thursday, October 15, 3:00 to 6:00 PM
WHERE: Reserve Padel Hudson Yards, 360 10th Ave, New York, NY 10001
WHO: 100+ VCs, family offices, LPs, lenders, HNWIs and select founders. Every guest is vetted.

What to expect:
- Padel courts and open play, all levels welcome (or just watch with a drink in hand)
- Open bar and food throughout the evening
- Live DJ
- A room seated by needs and assets, not name badges
- Photographers on site

The evening is also the official launch of Synapse Network, an invitation-only platform for the people who move capital. It's presented by Synapse and Investor Signals.

Tickets are $500. You can secure yours here:
https://commas.com/checkout/wqw6RYltHWnOG

Spots are limited by design, so I'd grab yours soon. Someone from our team will also give you a quick call, and you can reply here with any questions.

See you on the 15th,

Bryce Holloway
CEO, Investor Signals
investorsignals.co
